import pathlib, re
A = pathlib.Path("adapters")
bump   = "a01 a08 a11 a14 a17 a24 a27 a30 a33 a40 a43 a46".split()
rename = "a03 a06 a09 a16 a19 a22 a25 a32 a35 a38 a41 a48".split()
retire = "a04 a07 a10 a13 a20 a23 a26 a29 a36 a39 a42 a45".split()
timeout = {"a02":574,"a05":685,"a12":944,"a15":1055,"a18":1166,"a21":1277,"a28":1536,"a31":1647,"a34":1758,"a37":1869,"a44":2128,"a47":2239}
def T(n, kind, v=None):
    h = f'"""Transport adapter {n}."""\n\n'
    if kind=="bump":   return h+f'VERSION = 2\n\n\ndef handle(payload):\n    return {{"adapter": "{n}", "version": VERSION, "payload": payload}}\n'
    if kind=="rename": return h+f'VERSION = 1\n\n\ndef dispatch(payload):\n    return {{"adapter": "{n}", "version": VERSION, "payload": payload}}\n'
    if kind=="retire": return h+f'VERSION = 1\nDEPRECATED = True\n\n\ndef handle(payload):\n    raise NotImplementedError\n'
    if kind=="timeout":return h+f'VERSION = 1\nTIMEOUT_MS = {v}\n\n\ndef handle(payload):\n    return {{"adapter": "{n}", "version": VERSION, "payload": payload, "timeout_ms": TIMEOUT_MS}}\n'
exp = {n:T(n,"bump") for n in bump}
exp.update({n:T(n,"rename") for n in rename})
exp.update({n:T(n,"retire") for n in retire})
exp.update({n:T(n,"timeout",v) for n,v in timeout.items()})
assert len(exp)==48
bad=[]
for n,e in sorted(exp.items()):
    got=(A/f"{n}.py").read_bytes()
    if got!=e.encode(): bad.append(n)
print("byte-exact mismatches:", bad or "none")
todo=[p.name for p in A.iterdir() if p.is_file() and "TODO(migration)" in p.read_text(errors="ignore")]
print("TODO(migration) remaining:", todo or "none")
stray=[str(p) for p in pathlib.Path(".").rglob("*") if p.is_file() and not re.fullmatch(r"(adapters/(__init__|a\d\d)\.py|tests/(__init__|test_migration)\.py|README\.md)", str(p)) and "__pycache__" not in str(p)]
print("stray files:", stray or "none")
print("README bytes:", pathlib.Path("README.md").stat().st_size, "| test file bytes:", pathlib.Path("tests/test_migration.py").stat().st_size)
EOF

import pathlib,re,collections

for p in sorted(pathlib.Path('adapters').glob('a*.py')):
    n=p.stem; t=p.read_text().replace(n,'aXX')
    t=re.sub(r'TIMEOUT_MS = \d+','TIMEOUT_MS = N',t)
    g[t].append(n)
print('distinct normalized shapes:',len(g))
for t,ns in g.items():
    print('=====',len(ns),' '.join(ns)); print(repr(t))
"
